insurer: Universal Sompo General Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Policy wording covers room, boarding and nursing expenses but does not state any specific room rent cap or category limit

icu.note: ICU charges are covered as part of hospitalisation expenses but no specific cap or sub-limit is mentioned

copayment.note: A co-payment of 20% applies on each and every claim for insured persons above 55 years of age

sub_limits.display: Package charges capped at 75% of SI
sub_limits.note: Hospitalisation under agreed package charges of hospital restricted to 75% of sum insured; maternity capped at 5% of SI; ambulance Rs.1,000/policy period; health check-up 1% of avg SI per 3-year block; funeral Rs.1,000; out-of-pocket for child hospitalisation Rs.1,000

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible mentioned in the policy wording

initial_waiting.note: Expenses for any illness within 30 days of first policy commencement are excluded except accidents

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases excluded for 36 months of continuous coverage from inception; no optional reduction mentioned

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, piles, arthritis, joint replacement, sinusitis, kidney stones, etc.) excluded for 12 months; if also a PED, longer period applies

maternity.note: Maternity expenses including childbirth and complications covered after 9 months from policy inception; capped at 5% of sum insured; newborn treatment also covered under this limit

cumulative_bonus.note: Policy mentions cumulative bonus in definitions and migration/portability clauses but does not specify the rate or maximum percentage

restoration.note: No restoration or reinstatement of sum insured benefit mentioned in the policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Medical expenses incurred in the 30 days immediately prior to hospitalisation are covered

post_hosp.note: Medical expenses incurred in the 60 days immediately after discharge are covered

day_care.note: Day-care treatment covered; specific listed procedures (dialysis, chemotherapy, eye surgery, lithotripsy, D&C, tonsillectomy) explicitly mentioned; general day-care definition also included

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered when patient cannot be moved to hospital or no room is available

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment defined and included; specific limits not stated beyond general sum insured

organ_donor.note: Cost of organ harvesting explicitly listed as a covered medical expense under Section A

ambulance.note: Ambulance charges limited to Rs.1,000 per policy period for admissible claims

modern_treatments.note: Policy wording does not explicitly mention robotic surgery or other modern/advanced treatments; general surgical procedures are covered

consumables.note: Annexure A lists a large number of consumables (gloves, masks, nebuliser kits, etc.) as explicitly excluded from coverage

global_cover.note: Section C explicitly excludes treatment taken outside the geographical limits of India

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no look-back applies; claims cannot be contested except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions

grace_period.note: 15 days grace for monthly premium mode; 30 days for quarterly/half-yearly/annual modes

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document for policies of one year or more

portability.note: Portability to another insurer permitted with transfer of credits for PED waiting, specific waiting periods, no-claim bonus and moratorium

notable_exclusions.display: Treatment outside India, adventure sports injuries, gender-change, cosmetic surgery, infertility/IVF, alcoholism/drug abuse, OPD, refractive error <7.5D

optional_riders.display: Personal Accident Death Cover (optional add-on, lump sum benefit)
